name: True Odds
source:
Let's say you get the chance to make changes in your boring life or... even get the chance to have a whole new one. But since nothing comes for free, you first have to participate in a game you have never played, in a playroom you have never been before. 

[From [url=https://atticsalt.itch.io/true-odds]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
假设你有机会改变无聊的人生，甚至获得全新人生。但世上没有免费的午餐：首先，你必须参加一场从未玩过的游戏，地点还是从未去过的游戏室。

[来源：[url=https://atticsalt.itch.io/true-odds]Itch.io[/url]]
